item.title: Lola
item.description: Lola is a very affectionate dog who loves to be close to her humans. She’s perfect for someone who wants a lap dog and constant companion.

item.title: Teddy
item.description: Teddy is like a living teddy bear - soft, fluffy, and absolutely adorable. He’s great with children and loves to be cuddled and petted.
